manifest.name: dsh-boot-sequence-nice
manifest.description: A configurable boot sequence for DeepSeek Harness: play your own video/image phases full-screen before the app UI, then reveal the app. Ships no third-party artwork.

bundle.text:
# dsh-boot-sequence-nice bundle patch
#
# 这个插件只有宿主半边：订阅 webserver/index-inject，把启动序列的
# 样式 + 运行时 + 配置合成一个 <script> 注入 <head>，在应用 UI 之前铺满全屏。
#
# 它不注册客户端条目，所以 profile 里只需要这一行。
- insert:
    - id: boot-sequence
      name: dsh-boot-sequence-nice

readme.text:
[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

[](https://github.com/gxz19940730-blip/dsh-boot-sequence-NICE/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的**可配置启动序列**：在应用 UI 之前铺一层全屏画面，按你配置的顺序播放视频/图片，最后黑场收尾、让界面缓缓亮起。

- 只有宿主半边，不注册客户端条目
- 首帧早于应用 UI（查询期注入 `<head>`）
- 只动 `opacity` / `transform`，不触发布局
- 随时可跳过；支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`；跑完把节点和样式拆干净
- **不附带任何第三方美术资源**：默认底是 CSS 生成的抽象画面，视频/图片由你自己放进 `media/`

从 GitHub 安装（推荐，不需要 npm 账号）：

` ash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:gxz19940730-blip/dsh-boot-sequence-NICE

dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:gxz19940730-blip/dsh-boot-sequence-NICE#v0.1.0
`

本地开发：

` ash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:<本仓库绝对路径>
`

> 国内网络直连 GitHub 常常失败。装之前先给 git 配代理，例如：
> git config --global http.https://github.com/.proxy http://127.0.0.1:7890

npm 版本（可选，发布后可用）：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-boot-sequence-nice

插件根目录的 `boot.config.json`，改完刷新页面即可（宿主按配置签名自动重新合成，无需重启）。

```json
{
  "mediaBase": "/dsh-boot-sequence-nice/media",
  "fadeMs": 600,
  "minShowMs": 1200,

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `phases` | `[{type:"blank",duration:1400}]` | 播放顺序；`type` 为 `video` / `image` / `blank` |
| `phases[].src` | — | 相对 `media/` 的文件名；也接受 `/` 或 `http(s)` 开头的绝对地址 |
| `phases[].fit` | `cover` | `cover` 铺满 / `contain` 完整显示 |
| `phases[].duration` | 视频 30s 上限，图片 2400ms | 单段时长；视频默认播到 `ended`，`duration` 是硬上限 |
| `fadeMs` | 600 | 段间交叉淡化 |
| `minShowMs` | 1200 | 最短展示时间，避免一闪而过 |
| `oncePerSession` | false | 同一标签页只播一次（`sessionStorage`） |
| `skip.click` / `skip.keys` | true / `Esc` `Space` `Enter` | 跳过方式；`click:false` 可关闭点击跳过 |
| `ending.blackoutMs` | 450 | 结束前淡到纯黑的时长 |
| `ending.holdMs` | 250 | 黑场停留 |
| `ending.revealMs` | 900 | 整层淡出、界面亮起的时长 |
| `brand` | 关闭 | 左下角可选文字行 |
| `hint` | 空 | 右下角跳过提示文案 |

```
media/
  intro.mp4      # 你自己的视频
  keyart.jpg     # 你自己的图片
```

- 支持 `mp4/webm/mov`、`jpg/png/webp/avif/gif`
- 由 `/dsh-boot-sequence-nice/media/<name>` 提供，**支持 HTTP Range**（视频可拖动、可流式播放）
- 查找顺序：插件的 `media/` → `~/.dsh/boot-sequence-media/`（推荐放这里，重装插件不会丢）
- 路径做了目录逃逸校验，只能读这两个目录下的文件
- 视频建议 `-movflags +faststart`，让 moov 在文件头，首帧更快

```
GET /dsh-boot-sequence-nice/health
→ {"ok":true,"plugin":"dsh-boot-sequence-nice","version":"0.1.0","phases":["video","image"],"screenBytes":...}
```

```bash
node tools/selftest.mjs   # mock ctx：注入、健康检查、媒体路由（200/206/越权 404）
node tools/preview.mjs    # 生成 dist/preview.html，浏览器直接看
```

- **不做生成物**：`screen.css` + `runtime.js` + 配置在每次渲染时合成，改样式即时生效。
- **不做内联图片**：媒体走路由，脚本体积恒定在几 KB。
- **不做复杂时间轴**：段与段之间只有淡入淡出，够用、好维护。
- **失败即静默**：合成失败就返回空注入，绝不挡住应用启动。
MIT。本仓库不含任何游戏/第三方美术资源，`media/` 由使用者自行提供，相关素材版权归各自权利人。

[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

[](https://github.com/gxz19940730-blip/dsh-boot-sequence-NICE/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

A configurable **boot sequence** for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a full-screen layer that plays before the app UI — video and image phases in the order you choose — then fades to black and lets the app light up.

- Host-only: no client-side entries
- Paints before the app UI (injected into `<head>` while the index is rendered)
- Animates only `opacity` / `transform`
- Skippable at any time; honours `prefers-reduced-motion`; removes every node and style it added
- **Ships no third-party artwork**: the default backdrop is generated from CSS, and you supply your own video/images

From GitHub (recommended — no npm account needed):

` ash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:gxz19940730-blip/dsh-boot-sequence-NICE

dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:gxz19940730-blip/dsh-boot-sequence-NICE#v0.1.0
`

Local development:

` ash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:<absolute path to this repo>
`

> Direct GitHub access is unreliable in some networks. Configure a git proxy first, e.g.
> git config --global http.https://github.com/.proxy http://127.0.0.1:7890

npm (optional, once published): dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-boot-sequence-nice

Edit `boot.config.json` in the package root and refresh the page — no restart needed (the host re-composes whenever the config changes).

```json
{
  "mediaBase": "/dsh-boot-sequence-nice/media",
  "fadeMs": 600,
  "minShowMs": 1200,

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `phases` | `[{type:"blank",duration:1400}]` | Play order; `type` is `video`, `image` or `blank` |
| `phases[].src` | — | File name under `media/`; `/`-absolute and `http(s)` URLs also work |
| `phases[].fit` | `cover` | `cover` fills, `contain` letterboxes |
| `phases[].duration` | video 30s cap, image 2400ms | Phase length; video normally runs to `ended`, `duration` is the hard cap |
| `fadeMs` | 600 | Cross-fade between phases |
| `minShowMs` | 1200 | Minimum time on screen |
| `oncePerSession` | false | Play once per tab (`sessionStorage`) |
| `skip.click` / `skip.keys` | true / `Esc` `Space` `Enter` | How to skip; `click:false` disables click |
| `ending.blackoutMs` | 450 | Fade to black at the end |
| `ending.holdMs` | 250 | Time held on black |
| `ending.revealMs` | 900 | Fade-out that reveals the app |
| `brand` | off | Optional bottom-left text |
| `hint` | empty | Optional bottom-right skip hint |

```
media/
  intro.mp4      # your own video
  keyart.jpg     # your own image
```

- Supports `mp4/webm/mov`, `jpg/png/webp/avif/gif`
- Served at `/dsh-boot-sequence-nice/media/<name>` with **HTTP Range** support
- Lookup order: the package `media/` first, then `~/.dsh/boot-sequence-media/` (recommended — survives reinstalls)
- Path traversal is rejected; only those two directories are readable
- For video, use `-movflags +faststart` so the first frame arrives sooner

```
GET /dsh-boot-sequence-nice/health
→ {"ok":true,"plugin":"dsh-boot-sequence-nice","version":"0.1.0","phases":["video","image"],"screenBytes":...}
```

```bash
node tools/selftest.mjs   # mocked ctx: injection, health, media routes (200 / 206 / traversal 404)
node tools/preview.mjs    # writes dist/preview.html you can open in a browser
node tools/preview.mjs --config examples/video-then-image.json
```

- **No build artifacts**: `screen.css` + `runtime.js` + config are composed per render, so style edits apply immediately.
- **No inlined images**: media goes through a route; the injected script stays a few KB.
- **No complex timeline**: phases only cross-fade. Enough, and easy to maintain.
- **Fail silent**: if composition fails, nothing is injected and the app still starts.
MIT. This repository contains no game or third-party artwork. Anything you place in `media/` is yours, and its rights remain with the respective owners.
